summary: Dishonored franchise entries added as supplemental sourced guide rows; Sami did not list these in the locked personal spine.

entries.title: Dishonored: Rat Assassin

primary.why: Dishonored: Rat Assassin is documented as a free iOS spin-off released ahead of Dishonored. It has no sourced modern port, so the original iOS release is only an archival target.
primary.how_to_play: Use a legitimately retained iOS install on compatible legacy hardware if available; otherwise preserve captures and metadata.

entries.remaster_caveats: Promotional mobile spin-off; not a replacement for Dishonored.

entries.title: Dishonored
entries.definitive_edition: Windows version with all DLC / GOTY content

primary.version: Dishonored Definitive Edition / GOTY content on PC
primary.why: Dishonored released on PlayStation 3, Windows, and Xbox 360, with a Game of the Year Edition containing all DLC and a Definitive Edition for PlayStation 4 and Xbox One. Windows with all DLC installed is the best archive route because it has the highest capture/settings ceiling.
primary.how_to_play: Use the Windows version with The Knife of Dunwall, The Brigmore Witches, Dunwall City Trials, and Void Walker's Arsenal installed.

entries.remaster_caveats: Console Definitive Edition is complete but not a fidelity win over PC.

entries.title: Dishonored 2

primary.why: Dishonored 2 released on PlayStation 4, Windows, and Xbox One. Windows is the highest-fidelity archive route because it offers the strongest capture/settings path.
primary.how_to_play: Use the current Windows version through Steam/GOG/Game Pass where owned. Apply community fixes/settings before capture.

entries.remaster_caveats: No remaster replacing the Windows route is logged.

entries.title: Dishonored: Death of the Outsider

primary.why: Death of the Outsider is a standalone expansion following Dishonored 2, released on PlayStation 4, Windows, and Xbox One. Windows is the highest-fidelity archive route because it offers the strongest capture/settings path.
primary.how_to_play: Use the current Windows version. Play it after Dishonored 2 because it follows that story.

entries.remaster_caveats: Standalone expansion, not DLC inside Dishonored 2.
